description:
Keep nighttime necessities close at hand with the French Country 3 Drawer Nightstand. This charming nightstand brings the warmth of French Country design to your nursery while providing practical storage for all your essentials.

Three smooth-gliding drawers with dovetail construction offer organized space for pacifiers, lotions, burp cloths, books, and more. The spacious tabletop is perfect for a lamp, baby monitor, or a framed photo. Crafted from solid wood with a durable finish, this nightstand is built to last through every stage of childhood.

The turned legs and gently curved details echo the classic French Country aesthetic, coordinating perfectly with the full French Country collection.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
